_comment: Negelir centralized version chart. Single source of truth. Edit ONLY through `make version.bump`. Hand-edits will fail the canonical-form test.

ai.description: Python AI pipeline (scrapers, model, NLP, orchestrator).

infra_mock.description: Mock-data dev stack (Phase 2: nginx-mock, CA, seeds).

source_watcher.description: Source-watcher AI agent (Phase 2.8: schema drift detector).

datasource_scraper.description: (Pivot v3) Scraper component — fetches bytes from real or mock upstreams. R2 scaffold.

datasource_watcher.description: (Pivot v3) Source-watcher (renamed from source_watcher in R1). R2 scaffold.

datasource_refresher.description: (Pivot v3) Content-freshness agent (per-Record change detection). R3 scaffold.

datasource_patcher.description: (Pivot v3) Auto-patching scraper. R3 scaffold; gated by NEGELIR_PATCHER=1.

datasource_gitops.description: (Pivot v3) PR driver + auto-merge policy. R3 scaffold.

datasource_emitter.description: (Pivot v3) Projects DB/Redis state into NDJSON+Parquet feeds. R3 scaffold.

swarm.description: (Pivot v3) AI consumers — predictors, proofreaders, drift, defense, NLP, reactors. Inherits ai/model/nlp share.

common.description: (Pivot v3) Shared libraries — config schema, Record envelope, feed manifests, bus SDK.

competitions.description: (Phase 13a+) CompetitionConfig + CompetitionStage + CalibrationProfile resolver. Anchor: design/COMPETITIONS.md.

league_catalog.description: (Phase 13a+) Global league catalog + T1/T2/T3 readiness gating. Anchor: design/LEAGUE_CATALOG.md.

monetization.description: (Phase 20) Tier-based entitlement engine + per-token quotas. Ships dormant. Anchor: design/MONETIZATION.md.

enrichment_roster.description: (Phase 21) Plane 6 — transfers, contracts, suspensions. Anchor: design/ENRICHMENT_DATA.md §2.

enrichment_health.description: (Phase 21) Plane 7 — injuries, per-fixture availability. Anchor: design/ENRICHMENT_DATA.md §3.

enrichment_officials.description: (Phase 21) Plane 8 — referee assignments + rolling profiles. Anchor: design/ENRICHMENT_DATA.md §4.

enrichment_environment.description: (Phase 21) Plane 9 — weather forecast/actual + pitch condition. Anchor: design/ENRICHMENT_DATA.md §5.
